<font size= 4>A list of every '''entity''' within in Rooms: Found Footage RENOVATED. They are only 57 '''entities''' that the player can meet naturally, 132 if you count Admin, Removed, Modifier and Upcoming '''Entities'''. There are also the [[Red Rooms]] where '''entities''' get more common. Most '''entities''' are in [[Sections]]. There are 5 in game [[Sections]] being [[Section A]], [[Section D]], [[Section M]], the [[Unnamed Sector]], and [[Section E]], with [[Section R]] potentially coming later in the future.</font>
